insightsExplorerCustomChart.functionDescription: The buildChartOptions function will be called to build the custom chart options for Apache ECharts, and the function name must be 'buildChartOptions'
insightsExplorerCustomChart.functionReturnDescription: An object representing the Apache ECharts chart options. For detailed information on Apache ECharts chart options, please refer to the official documentation: https://echarts.apache.org/en/option.html
insightsExplorerCustomChart.transactionsFieldsDescription: An array of transaction information objects
insightsExplorerCustomChart.allTransactionFieldsDescription: Available fields of each transaction object:

transactionField.unixTime: Transaction time as a Unix timestamp in seconds
transactionField.year: Gregorian calendar year in the transaction timezone
transactionField.month: Gregorian calendar month (1–12) in the transaction timezone
transactionField.dayOfMonth: Day of the month (1–31) in the transaction timezone
transactionField.dayOfWeek: Day of the week (0–6, Sunday is 0) in the transaction timezone
transactionField.utcOffset: Transaction timezone offset from UTC in minutes
transactionField.type: Transaction type, corresponding to a value in TransactionType
transactionField.destinationAccountName: Destination account name, available for transfer transactions
transactionField.sourceCurrency: Currency code of the source account
transactionField.destinationCurrency: Currency code of the destination account, available for transfer transactions
transactionField.sourceAmount: Source amount (including two decimal places expressed without a decimal separator, for example '12345' represents 123.45)
transactionField.destinationAmount: Destination amount (available for transfer transaction, format is the same as the source amount)
transactionField.sourceAmountInDefaultCurrency: Source amount converted to the user's default currency (unavailable when the exchange rate is missing, format is the same as the source amount)
transactionField.destinationAmountInDefaultCurrency: Destination amount converted to the user's default currency (available for transfer transactions when the exchange rate exists, format is the same as the source amount)
transactionField.geoLocation: Transaction geolocation containing latitude and longitude
transactionField.inQueries: Names of all matching exploration queries in query order (empty when no queries are configured)

insightsExplorerCustomChart.chartColorsDescription: The chart color palette configured in the application
insightsExplorerCustomChart.sumTransactionAmountsDescription: Calculates the sum of the source amounts of the transactions
insightsExplorerCustomChart.sumTransactionAmountsReturnDescription: Returns the sum of the source amounts of the transactions, as a number
